## Draft / HOLD — documentation implementation in progress

This is the single integration candidate for **DOCS-RENAISSANCE-001**, implementing the owner's expanded current-documentation brief and the relevant scope of #592. It builds on accepted historical isolation in #584 and preserves #571's historical boundary.

**Do not promote to Ready, merge, release, or treat this documentation qualification as physical owner acceptance.** Independent source review, additional guide reconciliation, preserved evidence and the final decision packet are still being integrated.

## Reader experience already implemented

- A rewritten root README with genuine CyberSand imagery, clear product positioning and a concise source-checkout start.
- Six practical desktop/Workbench guides for first launch, first session, painting/history, Art, saving/Flatten and showcases.
- An audience-oriented documentation portal and current developer onboarding.
- Source-reconciled ownership, materials/Water, generation, persistence and actor references.
- A concise current-state register, actionable handover, approved-intent synthesis and explicit validation/source-custody guidance.

Review the [README](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/blob/docs/docs-renaissance-001/README.md), [documentation portal](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/blob/docs/docs-renaissance-001/docs/README.md) and [first Workbench session](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/blob/docs/docs-renaissance-001/docs/operations/workbench-first-session.md).

## Bounded retrieval correction

Measured fallback discovery admitted previously excluded execution packets and omitted current guides. The narrow documentation-tooling change shares selection rules, adds explicit-only routing to the 27 already-excluded focused packets, rejects malformed selection metadata, and preserves explicit historical envelopes. It does not change BM25 scoring, original frozen questions, engine code or CI scheduling. A separate versioned 36-question set and independent context/answer audits are being retained.

## Source and review scope

Accepted source baseline: `00cdb02f103265b6dc5224c68283e9a0c8cb449f`. Active engineering branches remain separate. No AGENTS binding-policy change, runtime/dependency change, owner-save change or paid model dispatch is included.

Genuine new native material captures and retained showcase images carry provenance. Graphical desktop capture was blocked by the hosted display/socket environment; rendered README previews are explicitly static approximations. Native compilation, hosted output, package qualification and physical acceptance remain distinct.

The final update will include exact coverage, inventory/claim dispositions, preserved-source and inbound-link checks, retrieval baseline/revised results including regressions, independent findings and the final validation matrix. This PR does not close #592 or retire #571.

## Purpose and disposition

**Draft / HOLD. No merge, Ready promotion, production activation, release, paid inference or training.**

This continuation gives the ordinary Workbench a richer native construction kit, explicit connections, contextual retrieval, bounded procedural work and owner-reviewed hierarchical construction. It preserves #770 ancestry and leaves #720, #770, their frozen evidence and their owner evaluators unchanged.

## Frozen application and current qualification

- Application: `fc8194c00294d54a0e148aa933ccfb57ce194c6e`.
- Tree: `d632b6b77f7829c1e61d035844b52060c972e908`, exactly equal to reviewed local `a8dbe1142707f0f7520fd8c6e720d5ecb7ba804b`.
- Foundation: #770 archival `f5f6e9f35727d81868bcced4da8b913b470ea635`; accepted main remains `00cdb02f103265b6dc5224c68283e9a0c8cb449f`.
- Dedicated existing four-job campaign: [45506178712](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/actions/runs/45506178712). Source guards and the source-matched Windows runtime build passed. Linux and Windows application qualification is running; displayed/full-World and pristine extracted-evaluator outcomes remain pending.

All105 normalized native inputs match the original Batch and #770 foundations. Existing source-exact platform build gates remain in force. A successful ancestor or documentation child supplies no new application PASS.

## Working authoring system

- **40 distinct parts**, including the original eight unchanged. Version2 occupied integer point/line contacts, opposing orientation, full/overlap contact, finite capacity and alias/occupancy guards preserve v1 interpretation. Deterministic bounded snap search proposes poses for review.
- **Practical module tools:** search, cached thumbnails, anchors/connectors, compact semantic editing, transforms, compatible role palettes, bounded variable detail, import/export, current-native observation and historical provenance.
- **Eight code-owned local workers:** ribs, trim, anchored clutter, panels, infill, short pipes, frames and guarded wear. Current native source and live part scopes constrain every proposal.
- **One host-owned workflow:** the existing StageSession and ordinary Art executor/PAINT authority perform native mutation. Exact preview tickets, source/dependency revalidation, finite task/retry/history budgets, explicit stage approval, Stop and verified terminal receipts separate proposals from construction.
- **Finite hierarchy and recovery:** the delegated workshop demonstrates explicit Skip, a refused gallery repaired through the owner controls, three different procedural jobs, an acknowledged4096-cell partial prefix and a fresh recovery campaign. A later manual edit invalidates the convenience recovery.
- **Knowledge and composition:** the existing25 GOLDMAPS cards feed compact contextual retrieval and compatible part selection. The actual identified70-map upstream knowledge export was independently hash-verified and parsed read-only; it replaces neither the25-card cohort nor refused originals with native modules.
- **Four large native Worlds:** orbital fabrication hall1024×1024, terraced arcology1024×1024, monumental viaduct1536×768 and biomechanical vault1024×768, each composed through stages no larger than512×512.

## Independently reviewed development evidence

Pinned Godot4.7/default1024 execution of the refined workshop passed89 native checks and12 checks in a fresh process. Independent reduction verifies10 native stages,20 chunks,49,898 changed material rows,128 final attachment contacts and the exact256-cell permitted exterior exception.

All four refined flagship Worlds passed446 native checks at their recorded development source. Independent replay verifies55 stages,337 receipt chunks,1,160,376 changed material rows and exact complete material planes. Changed rows count writes across stages, not unique occupied final cells. Diagnostic native maps are distinct from Godot framebuffers; current hosted graphical evidence remains pending.

The original reduced-capacity full-World scheduling failure, interrupted runs and earlier crop mismatch remain recorded. A new focused full-World hangar trial at default1024 passed32 checks with actual Midge movement and persistent landing contact; this one-family headless result does not replace the final four displayed trials.

The preserved #770 thirty-case study did not identify a causal retrieval/prompt advantage: its contextual arms had identical matched geometry. The new frozen60-proposal comparison has23 actual completions and37 pre-native refusals. Retrieval completed6/8 held-out cases versus0/8 for each other finite policy, across only three feasible independently authored held-out briefs; two seeds are repeated conditions. All ten refusals of the contradictory pressure-dock brief remain in the denominator. This is a particular selection/tool-capability comparison, not model intelligence or expert preference.

The24-case detail study exactly replays all native results. Six additive random controls leave20–240 unattached cells versus zero for the anchored procedures. Identical frame arms, invariant panel/pipe seeds and non-discriminating random-wear component counts remain explicit.

## Art and model boundary

Art #773's current `fa22d386b802b686c371bb6e12996c7a93c18588` evaluator is separately qualified by run45497650568 using its recorded application-reuse proof. Its earlier failed package is historical evidence.

An isolated43-check probe verifies the qualified Provider callback boundary with zero HTTP/model/native calls. The remaining dependency is an exclusively owned proposal-only dispatch/completion route and explicit handoff; the ordinary Art response still reaches auto-paint. The owner must forward the live-context guard through the optional eleventh `Provider.send` argument. No Art successor is silently imported, no competing completion listener is attached, and no credentials/transport are duplicated.

The shipped Intent workflow is explicitly deterministic/offline. **Genuine model calls remain zero.** No approved local model was observed in this executor. Physical owner Windows/NVIDIA acceptance and aesthetic preference remain separate gates.

## Review and delivery

The exact Windows ZIP, checksum, full manifest and real extracted launcher must pass before a new evaluator is called qualified. Final source/runtime outcomes and all meaningful negatives will be retained in a documentation/evidence-only child, distinct from the tested application.

- [Decision packet](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/blob/fc8194c00294d54a0e148aa933ccfb57ce194c6e/docs/audits/2026-11-24-world-steer-m6-m7/FINAL-DECISION-PACKET.md)

- [Planning and composition](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/blob/fc8194c00294d54a0e148aa933ccfb57ce194c6e/docs/systems/architecture-planning-and-composition.md)

No native C++ inputs, production physics/material defaults or unrelated active owner branches are changed. Art, PUBPRES, ObjectShard, Equipment, Materials Lab, SWARM, Strata, Actor Compose, RAMCACHE, AMBIENT, goblin, documentation and CI ownership remain separate.

## Why this change

The editable Strata predecessor supplies four-plane ownership and presentation. This successor makes that foundation useful for building layered native environments: local artwork can become reviewed editable material geometry, native parts can be reused on explicit planes, and bounded visual atmosphere can add motion without another Play simulation.

**Draft/HOLD.** No Ready promotion, merge, default activation or physical Windows/NVIDIA acceptance is authorized.

## Delivered implementation

- Ordinary Workbench Layers, Import, Compose, Atmosphere and Scenes workflow, retaining default-OFF lazy activation and the existing camera, worker, Play World and Rapier actors.
- Deterministic local PNG import with crop, exact grid transforms, integer sampling, explicit palette/distance/alpha/mask policy, zero-write review, native approval and independent readback. Transparent Overlay pixels preserve destination cells; explicit Empty is a distinct operation.
- Exact masked native modules, harvesting/export, eight reusable parts and three finite layered presets. Plans use at most 4096 cells per native request, actual owner/revision/permission fences, dependency acknowledgements, retained Stop prefixes and existing per-plane history.
- Separate reviewed depth/atmosphere preset application after native construction; no material writes from visual settings.
- Six presentation-only motif kinds (haze, steam, rain, dust, beacon, machinery), bounded to 12 regions / 384 motifs. Decorative native Worlds remain static, paused and zero Hz.
- Strict CYSSTRAT v1 compatibility and v2 authored settings/provenance, including exact numeric round trips. Save is not evolved multi-World continuation.
- Five native environments: two 2048×1024, two 1024² and one 1024×1536; two source-pinned SANDMAPS reference crops with explicit authored masks and a synthetic alpha-cutout fixture.
- Source-bound Windows evaluator and offline actual-capture gallery generators, plus native, graphical, persistence, custody and failure-containment qualification.

## Source and ownership

The 45-second scene-admission target is unchanged. All five source3 Windows installs missed it: 52.798, 52.613, 48.529, 46.716 and 51.350 seconds. Static/animated windows made zero additional decorative native captures/uploads. Short hosted callback samples, paused maximum-extent observations and sampled process memory do not establish physical GPU FPS, sustained dense play or marginal decorative memory.

After a temporary executor reset, exact published source, original Actions archives and retained runtime bytes were recovered. Local headless execution is available; Unix socket creation remains refused, so local graphical/browser execution is not claimed.

issues.body:
## Outcome and acceptance boundary

This consolidates the Art provider, conversation UI, session logging, close timing and authoring lifecycle work into one source-qualified candidate on accepted main.

**Draft/HOLD. No merge, Ready promotion or automatic merge.** The integrated application is qualified on Linux and hosted Windows Godot 4.7, and the final Windows evaluator has passed its actual extracted launcher, immutable-file and loaded-module gates. The owner's physical Windows/NVIDIA acceptance remains pending.

**Owner correction preserved:** LM Studio was not running during the original multi-second freeze. The primary protocol is an absent listener → Send → Art's ordinary X/Hide. A live mock HTTP 404 is a separate condition and does not reproduce that report. This work repairs independently reproduced teardown and large-value processing defects; it does not assert an unproved cause or physical fix for the original no-server freeze.

## Exact source and evaluator

| Identity | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Candidate/package commit | `fa22d386b802b686c371bb6e12996c7a93c18588` |
| Candidate tree | `3245dfc9090a6f37a0e0824325b21e86b59d50a8` |
| Same-tree local review checkpoint | `d14a8985d4e062ecfa80bb6f461ba1d843c77f70` |
| Accepted main | `00cdb02f103265b6dc5224c68283e9a0c8cb449f` |
| Application matrix source | `981a740828decbeac04d5a14511d0222095de0a9`, tree `9e37f6c4113e51b7aa9969bd7f3cc726405467bf` |
| Windows evaluator | `art-workbench-final-windows.zip`, 92,551,375 bytes |
| Evaluator SHA-256 | `c1666f1b6cee269bea8e95c4d018f2f36dd3b246491a3754c83cc37d167f9f9f` |

[Qualified Windows artifact](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/actions/runs/45497650568/artifacts/14968792395) contains the evaluator ZIP and checksum. Extract the evaluator ZIP to a writable folder, then double-click **Open Workbench.cmd**. It needs no Git, Python, compiler or running model server. It opens the normal Workbench with Art, uses a package-local profile, leaves Image off for the primary reproduction, and sends no request automatically. **Ctrl+F12** writes a timing checkpoint; **Open diagnostics.cmd** opens the reports.

The package contains exact Godot 4.7, unchanged native/Rapier payloads, required VC runtime, notices, source identity, complete immutable hashes and `APPLICATION-QUALIFICATION.json`. The proof distinguishes the package commit from the application-tested commit. The published source bundle independently reconstructs the complete 21-commit suffix and final tree from a declared complete shallow accepted-main snapshot; local/API identity mappings and older failed controls are retained.

## What changed

- Preserve ordinary X as Hide and explicit Stop as cancellation. Keep World-generation and reentrant-audit fences before HTTP or native admission, including hidden-window and replacement paths.
- Use nonblocking HTTP polling, finite timeouts, bounded response allocation and disabled redirects. Connection/DNS/TLS/timeout, genuine HTTP errors, malformed responses and capacity failures remain distinct; failures do not fabricate assistant turns or usage.
- Prepare large incoming and outgoing values away from the UI thread. One preparation task per provider uses copied values, cooperative cancellation and credential-snapshot validation; workers never touch World or SceneTree. Durable journal append and native ordering remain on the main thread.
- Preserve accepted session-only JSONL and complete admitted redacted traffic, while bounding live/error projections and avoiding repeated parsing/filesystem work. Hide/reopen preserves the current game-session conversation; a new game session starts empty with an independent audit. Historical files remain untouched.
- Bound Note/conversation dialogs and scaled auxiliary windows, keep Apply/Cancel reachable, fill the actual editing area, populate very long conversation lists in frame slices and reject stale Apply. Large messages retain complete editable 4,096-character parts, with direct part-number navigation and clipboard paging before expensive text shaping.
- Preserve manual drawing, model-assisted authoring, partial native application, Stop, Undo/Redo and saved authored starts. Captured prompt/image/World state stays coherent while the owner edits or switches modes.
- Apply the exact #750/#756 NVIDIA and LM Studio presets, remove `astra5-6` from suggestions, retain custom identifiers/endpoints/history, and bind each Key dialog to its captured provider. Presets are not claims of API access, model availability or image support.
- Package from a fresh committed checkout with strict source checks. Canonical descriptor export preserves all settings; all four import descriptors now remain byte-identical after actual Windows first import. No immutable-file exclusion was added.

No native source rebuild or unrelated Batch Lab, PUBPRES, ObjectShard, Actor Compose or Architecture implementation is imported. Donor branches are preserved.

## Important design choices

| Choice | Reason and practical limit |
| --- | --- |
| Nonblocking HTTP with finite budgets | The controlled accepted-socket/no-header case exceeded a 30-second teardown watchdog with threaded HTTP. Polling avoids that blocking ownership path. The pinned 64 KiB read path advances with frames, so slow rendering reduces transfer throughput under the configured timeout. |
| Value preparation worker; durable append stays on the main thread | Large JSON/redaction work can finish or be cancelled without accessing native/scene objects. Complete admitted receipts retain ordering. Slow storage and total heap remain measurable limits. |
| Complete 4,096-character editable parts | A single giant text widget caused multi-second shaping pauses. All content and edits are retained. Changing parts or pasting across parts resets local text Undo; Cancel still discards the whole draft, and native World Undo/Redo is independent. |
| Preserve #727's session-only contract | Collaboration persists within the current game session, including Hide/reopen. Automatic cross-session transcript restoration would change the accepted contract; historical audit files are retained. |
| Reuse only unchanged application qualification | A fail-closed gate checks the seven explicit packaging/workflow/test/guide paths, protected trees, fixed prior run/jobs, immutable artifact digests and all 12 groups per platform. Any other source change requires full application tests. Fresh package/launcher/module acceptance always runs separately. |

## Qualified evidence

[Application run 45482969231](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/actions/runs/45482969231) exercised the actual native Shared Workbench, isolated profiles, real loopback fixtures, Godot UI hit testing and displayed Linux/Windows paths. All application groups passed. The original Windows overall job subsequently failed at packaging; that failure remains explicit in every reuse proof.

| Application check on `981a7408` | Linux | Windows |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Complete matrix groups | 12 | 12 |
| Headless matrix assertions | 928 | 928 |
| Displayed matrix assertions | 903 | 904 |
| Panel UI assertions, headless/displayed | 275 / 279 | 275 / 279 |
| Displayed native clipboard assertions | 71 | 71 |
| Evaluator-input assertions per mode | 18 | 18 |
| Complete redacted response bodies independently rehashed | 16 | 16 |
| Complete changed conversations independently rehashed | 2 | 2 |

Conditional assertion-count differences are documented as unobserved conditions, not invented passes. The matrix covers absent listeners, immediate refusal, delayed connection, stalled/delayed HTTP, invalid model, malformed/oversized bodies, visible/X/Stop/reopen, incoming/outgoing preparation, native drawing, World replacement and real process exit with unfinished work.

The edited 16,769,024-byte conversation applied in **354.215 ms Linux / 413.840 ms Windows** in the displayed runs, with its complete content hash and zero HTTP admission. Windows's 16,773,283-byte assistant response completed with HTTP 200 after **48.129 seconds**, matched its complete audit body, and had a maximum frame of **823.830 ms in that case**. Transport duration and UI/callback/JSON/audit/native timing remain separate. The two-second adjacent-frame and cancellation/exit gates remain unchanged.

[Final package run 45497650568](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/actions/runs/45497650568), source `fa22d386`, passed:

- Actual fixed-evidence/source proof, 30 proof-boundary tests and 7 Linux package tests, without skips.
- Fresh committed Windows source/runtime staging and 7 Windows package tests, without skips.
- Actual delivered command launcher from an extracted path containing spaces, native Workbench readiness, orderly teardown and exit 0.
- Strict post-launch verification of **all 1,098 immutable files**; exact before/after/source equality for all four vendor import descriptors.
- A complementary actual GUI process loading the expected Godot executable, native library, Rapier and VC runtime from that same copied installation with matching hashes.
- Independent full ZIP inventory, every payload SHA, source/recipe/LFS identity, licenses and privacy review. No profile, diagnostics, generated caches, session configuration, duplicate paths or symlinks are included.

The final installed run recorded **54.185 seconds to readiness**, a **49.253-second startup gap**, **161.351 ms maximum visible-idle frame**, and **391.459 ms teardown** under hosted software rendering. No Send/provider activity occurred in this smoke check. Cold startup is an explicit remaining performance boundary and is separate from the qualified post-startup interaction matrix.

[Final documentation/provenance run 45497650751](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/actions/runs/45497650751) passed 11 suites / 459 tests plus documentation/action/source checks. Its merge-preview commit has the exact candidate tree. The existing Draft materialized-repository gate was skipped, not counted as passed. The four existing retrieval misses remain recorded. Existing Draft policies also skipped native/GDExtension/palette rebuild campaigns.

## Source reconciliation and retained failures

| Record | Reconciled donor head |
| --- | --- |
| #756 model roster | `8093a782a13a078ad6fa4fc9fdf11b969cbbf52f` |
| #763 bounded conversation | `2d63bba23932feb2c051c11df9d0775c24ea451d` |
| #765 local-close investigation | `cb88ab25d6dbdc8b459431d0189332bb7d37188a` |
| #766 failed HTTP / hidden work | `48970266ae3b1ae47d2278d25ea312328078ddbd` |

#727 is the accepted session-only baseline. #713, #744, #750, #559 and #558 were inspected alongside current PR identities, comments, ownership and CI. #756 is actually non-Draft despite its title/body; this candidate is an actual Draft. Latest Architecture coordination remains a separate future proposal, without imported implementation.

Original artifacts, source mappings and negative controls are preserved. Earlier qualification found and corrected obsolete long-note assertions, incorrect root-versus-Art geometry checks, a total-list-loading cutoff, Windows clipboard LF/CRLF fixture semantics, a missed unfinished-worker Stop precondition and large-response fixture budgets under software frame pacing. Earlier controlled runtime failures include the >30-second accepted-socket teardown watchdog, 2.488-second near-limit response pause and 3.329-second outgoing Send frame.

Two packaging failures also remain explicit: `981a7408` failed a used-checkout guard whose rejected filenames were not retained; `2eedd8f3` built and launched but failed an import-descriptor hash check whose changed bytes were not retained. The final fresh-checkout/canonical-export run proves current stability without retroactively assigning an unproved cause to either missing observation. External local SIGKILLs and the brief workspace outage remain incomplete observations with no product-cause attribution.

## Owner acceptance

Use the [five-item owner checklist and engineering matrix](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/blob/fa22d386b802b686c371bb6e12996c7a93c18588/docs/operations/art-workbench-final-evaluation.md). First allow import and World setup to finish, then test LM Studio fully stopped → no local listener → Send → immediate ordinary X. Compare visible, Stop/X and reopen paths; check Note layout/paging, custom provider settings and manual/partial/native authoring.

Physical Windows/NVIDIA no-listener acceptance, actual OS DPI/monitor transitions and owner storage/driver behavior remain owner checks. No paid inference or private provider configuration was used. The timing report excludes prompts, response bodies, endpoints, model identifiers and keys; the separate complete redacted Art audit remains in the isolated profile.

[Integration evidence and design record](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/blob/fa22d386b802b686c371bb6e12996c7a93c18588/docs/audits/2026-11-24-art-workbench-final/README.md).

## Original M0–M2 implementation record

## Status — Draft / HOLD

## What works

Shared Workbench has an optional **Batch Lab…** entry, default OFF. It executes real 2×2 and 4×4 construction grids through independent native Worlds, using the accepted simulation worker, Art plan/executor, provider stack and World Art renderer.

Each attempt retains its configuration, prompt identity, host seed, source/result material planes, completed native receipts, accepted edits, errors, outcome and timings. The panel supports selection, full-resolution inspection, equivalent-scale comparison, blinded labels, zero-write preview, bounded Run/Stop, repeat/retry, replay, material Undo/Redo, Save/Open and export. Three supplied families are Architecture, Pipework and Greebles.

P0–P3 prompts, three inspected and hash-bound SANDMAPS reference cards, deterministic/seeded-random controls and a separate unseen cohort are versioned. [Launch, acceptance, ownership and evidence guide](../blob/feat/world-steer-batch-001-20261121/docs/operations/world-steer-batch-lab.md)

## Design choices and preserved boundaries

- Two bounded native owners serve up to sixteen tiles. Each restores its own copied material baseline; this static M0–M2 prototype preserves dynamic material identities without advancing their simulation.
- Material replay is separate from ordinary Workbench history and complete actor/physics checkpoints. Existing native IDs, physics defaults and ordinary save formats are preserved.
- Batch destinations retain the accepted Art material allowlist. Source capture preserves all native stored IDs.
- Local-provider requests reuse Art transport and redaction but retain transport JSONL in a separate fixed Batch namespace. Ordinary Art profile, archive and receipt ownership remain intact.
- Paid cloud selections produce explicit refusal records. No genuine model comparison or API spending has occurred.

The five concurrent missions' branches, workflows, evidence and experimental baselines are untouched. This branch adds its own request-scoped workflow. All **105 native source inputs remain unchanged**; both platform runtimes are nevertheless rebuilt for this candidate.

## Independent review and repairs

Separate native, UI/persistence, methodology, security/provenance and regression/release reviewers examined the implementation and confirmed repairs.

Material fixes include large partial replay, imported material/config identities, source-crop coordinates, cancellation recovery, UI lifecycle/cache/blinding, frozen versus editable result labels, complete PNG validation, request-owned credential redaction and equivalent provider context.

The combined campaign exposed a genuine cross-feature defect: a first Batch provider request could create an orphan ordinary Art archive and block subsequent manual Redo. Fixed namespace ownership now preserves an existing Art profile/archive byte-for-byte and supports the fresh-user sequence. Follow-up checks closed JSON field-name/body/header credential echoes and actual file-alias writes while retaining trusted native receipt keys.

A baseline PAINT regression incorrectly assumed replacement always cancelled before any old-World work. Its strengthened test validates the exact retired receipt and confirmed prefix, then independently reads every replacement cell. A forced **8,192-cell** old-World partial left the entire **262,144-cell** replacement Empty.

Windows qualification of the preceding `9c9e61df` candidate exposed CRLF conversion of the four versioned prompt files. Godot's editor normalized their display, causing an unchanged prompt to be marked custom. A two-line Batch-only `.gitattributes` repair preserves committed LF bytes. An independent fresh `core.autocrlf=true` checkout reproduced the original failure and passed the unchanged **68/0** lifecycle suite after repair. Application logic and tests are unchanged. [Original platform campaign and retained evidence](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/actions/runs/44961328440): its Linux job subsequently passed every native/application/graphical/regression gate; the Windows job remains failed and did not publish an evaluator.

## Experimental interpretation and remaining gates

The native pilot retains **68 completed, 4 partial, 2 refused and 1 stopped** attempts; 72 have evaluable native material planes. Its 48 procedural family executions are twelve family/seed blocks repeated across P0–P3. Twelve random executions are three blocks; only three family blocks have paired controls. P0–P3 deterministic results are identical within matched blocks.

Random pipework and architecture fail declared structural checks, but random greebles also pass. That negative result shows the current metrics do not establish useful contextual greeble quality.
